Parsed native fields from authored #define declarations using balanced method arguments. Output declarations are listed separately.
Recorded each field source, type, default, codec, predicate group, operator, alias, column and expression.
The stock writer preimage lookup replaces the old structql ID and current-view helpers. Those helpers are execution details rather than omitted public request fields.
New private and aggregate readers are traced to their original SQL and application adapters separately. A missing tagged DTO is not proof of parity.

manual_findings.change: Replaced SQLite string concatenation with three independent LIKE predicates using bound values after trimming and lowercasing the query. Empty query presence does not filter rows.
legacy DTO cursor expression uses created_at, but live public page uses last_activity/updated_at/created_at. Canonical reader uses activity ordering.

old schedulerRunInput.Id means schedule_id whereas new historical legacyrun.ID means rowid; status oldnot_in/listLIKE vsnewexactstring. Public scheduler list/due use currentrun/cube with explicit mapping, not this historical maintenance reader.
manual_findings.unresolved: Raw old direct Datly URI compatibility remains an explicit component boundary difference. Public since mapping now has HTTP and native list/count proof.

manual_findings.change: Legacy elicId and convId query names are now elicitationId and conversationId in the consolidated reader. Application methods map the logical IDs explicitly. This does not claim the old raw URI aliases are accepted.

tests.coverage: actual native ByElicitation, ByParentElicitation and ByLinkedElicitation, wrong conversation, missing/empty elicitation

manual_findings.change: OAuth LinkState and Session previously used single pointers at body/data. Canonical writers accept slices. Application adapters explicitly wrap one row; the old and new raw component body shapes differ.

tests.coverage: native session Upsert/Get/Delete and OAuth state Create/owner/pending/consume wrappers

manual_findings.change: All 11 legacy codec tags belong to kind=param structql helpers for writer preimage IDs. No explicit codec is declared on a path, query or body request field in the 79 legacy Input structs.

The reader declares ConversationID from path/conversationId with predicate group 0, equal, alias t, column conversation_id. Protected GraphMode and batch IDs extend the input. It does not import the old GoalInput. The Init hook requires the ordinary conversation scope.

The public HTTP since query maps a strict turn ID into both current run and count views. An explicit empty string preserves the legacy no-filter behavior. Unknown IDs, whitespace-padded IDs and ISO timestamp strings do not match.

tests.coverage: 6 HTTP cases per database; store Has=false, adjacent pages with matching counts, and foreign owner filtering

Raw legacy component URI/body equivalence is not claimed.
